text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Alv. How about facing me in a match today?
I don't think it's a bad offer for you either.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Highly strategic board games train your critical thinking.
That in turn will prove useful for tactics during races.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"I don't need it.
I can formulate my own strategies."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Good grief—hm?
What's this, were you watching?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
! ...Yes.
You are—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I can talk easily with Alv-senpai.
We never seem to run out of things to say.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...If only I could talk to that person
just like you do—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh. In that case, a board game
would be right up your alley.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
It's a tool that allows for mutual understanding and communication
even without exchanging many words, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
While playing, there's always something to talk about naturally,
and even afterward, playing the same game gives you common ground.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Then, if we play a board game—I could too.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Of course. Your wish will surely come true.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Please.
Would you play a board game with me?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Even if it's just once, or if you stop halfway through, that's fine.
Please—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Please, I'm begging you.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
……Raise your head.
Very well, under those conditions.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Called with a request to "join in on a board game,"
I visited the hideout, only to find an unexpected guest waiting there.
choice_data_list: So it's the four of us hanging out this time, huh.
So we're playing with the four of us this time, huh?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Today we're playing Reversi—
except with special rules: a 2-on-2 team battle.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: "Each team will take turns placing a stone, and the side with the most stones when the board is full wins. Teammates are allowed to consult each other."
choice_data_list: I see. So, how are the teams split up?
I see. So, how are the teams split up?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Me and Trainer, Alv and Duramente.
Good to have you with me, partner.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the game began—
Taking turns in the order of Admire Groove,
Rulership, Duramente, and then myself.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Next, I'll pick here.
choice_data_list: (Does she want to take the corner early? Or maybe...)
(Do they want to take the corner early? Or maybe...)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hmm... In that case, I will place mine here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her opponent, Rulership, placed hers closer to the center. It looks like she's testing the waters.
Next is Duramente's turn, but how will she respond—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I shall take this side.
choice_data_list: (She sticks to the basics and plays it safe, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then it seems fine to leave that alone for now.
What we must do now is—keep Admire Groove in check.
I have to feed my partner as much intel on the enemy as possible."
choice_data_list: (First, I'll block her path and see how she reacts.)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No words were needed.
I had seen the board she envisioned so many times.
Her thoughts and the actions to take were both crystal clear.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: —Got it.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ho, you truly live up to the name of prodigy.
While aggressively pushing your attack, you never lose sight of board control.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: However—did you forget? This is a team battle.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! That place is...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You were acting to ease Alv's worries,
but you didn't fully comprehend the offensive strategy
she was envisioning.
choice_data_list: (A lack of harmony will lead to tears in our team's fabric.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry, Alv-senpai.
I couldn't move the way I did over there—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I can't keep up with Alv-senpai.
...All I do is hold her back.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: That is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
That's not true, Duramente.
Game playstyles vary wildly from person to person.
Alv is different from you, after all.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Besides, you're forgetting the most important thing.
—What kind of play did you want to make?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...I... together with Alve-senpai—
together...!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
......
Duramente-san.
It is my fault that you're being pushed back like this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Let's coordinate our efforts. And win.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes...!
choice_data_list: (This is shaping up to be a great match.)
(This looks like it'll be a great match.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Duramente-san, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yes, please leave it to me...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oho, making your move this time, are you?
An interesting strategy. Now then, my next move is—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"It's finally endgame!
—Let us awaken the sleeping lion!"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Letting you take the bottom edge was a setup.
All to narrow down your options—
choice_data_list: Limit where they can hit and overwhelm them all at once!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Heheh, a total victory. It really feels great when a strategy goes off without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: "...A total defeat. But I gave it everything I had, and being able to battle alongside you, Alve-senpai... made me happy."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...Your positioning wasn't bad."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ! Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: And they lived happily ever after, huh.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "...I won't let you. I knew you'd make your move."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Ruler, if you break through there,
then we'll take the other side—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
A draw, huh? Interesting!
—Now then, let's reset and go again.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —Alright! That's our win!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Both of you were incredible.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Besides... there's Alve-senpai too. She understood my intentions with just a few words.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Um... I know I said just once was enough.
But if possible... again, please.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Well, play a match with me whenever you feel like it.
I'm gonna keep bugging you to play anyway.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Did you really think I wouldn't read right through you?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So you had proper countermeasures prepared.
Indeed, it wasn't a move beyond your capability.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...No.
It's not just Alv-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"To think you'd show such strong coordination there.
Ha, bring it on! I'll take you on—"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh!! I lost...!
That was insanely fun, but it's beyond frustrating...!
Ah, what an utterly magnificent match that was!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... Extra training later, then. Still though—
looks like their plan worked out.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rulership looked ahead to see Duramente
happily talking to Admire Groove.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod at her eye contact.
Looking at the board, the subtle mind games are over.
All that's left is to make the move to settle this—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: You two had better brace yourselves...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, that was a truly magnificent victory.
Sometimes, having the audacity to make a big gamble is just what you need in gaming.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me, Alv-senpai.
I couldn't hold the line, and our formation collapsed—

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Don't apologize.
This was... our defeat.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much.
I'm so glad I got to spend time having fun with you today.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
You still gain something even when you lose.
That's the great thing about board games.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...A forceful move.
However, it isn't over yet.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Haha, that's the spirit.
Now then, Miss Prodigy. Let's see who drops first
in this test of endurance—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: —I won!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Still—that wasn't a clean victory.
I'll hone my skills so I can win decisively next time.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...!
Will you race against me again?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course.
Alf wouldn't want to stay a loser either, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I don't know.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—No.
With the way I am now... the way we are now!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. I never thought we'd be outdueled.
You two make quite the pair."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...
Well then.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
Um... I really learned a lot this time.
I was so happy to race together with you, Alv-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
...I still need to keep polishing my skills, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Rulership—
her expression could only be described as completely blank.
choice_data_list: (Ah, precisely because I can see three moves ahead—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Checkmate.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
I figured you'd get stronger if you worked together,
but I didn't expect you to actually beat us.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Or rather, you can communicate with Alv just fine.
You just need to speak your mind straight and without hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
――……
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that fierce battle really worked up an appetite.
Once we're done cleaning up, how about we do a post-game review over some snacks?
